jobs.title: Travelling Fleet Supervisor - Shore Excursions
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Shore Excursions Fleet Supervisor oversees all aspects of Shore Excursions on board MSC Fleet and Is responsible and accountable for driving sales through the effective coaching of the Shore Excursions teams in areas such as profit growth, expense control, product training, staff development and customer service. The goal is to ensure compliance with corporate standards, enhance operational excellence, maximize revenue performance, and improve customer satisfaction scores.

Your Impact

- Monitor and supervise the performance of the assigned ships to achieve Company's assigned targets.

- Support the onboard team to achieve maximum revenue and Guests' Satisfaction

- Ensure application/implementation of company standard and procedures

- Coach and train onboard teams ensuring active team participation

- Audit safety procedures in place with our Tour Operators

Your Journey so far

- At least 4 years of experience in the role of onboard Shorex Manager

- Fluent in English (minimum B2) and any additional language is a plus

- Computer proficiency with the MS Office Package

- Knowledge of onboard booking systems is an advantage

- Analytical skills

- Experience in training and people development

- Strong Interpersonal and Communication skills

- This is a crew contract involving a long period of travel on board our ships and our offices

The Fleet Supervisor’s activities are supervised and coordinated by the Corporate Team, to whom they report all actions, ideas, and implementations, while also providing relevant analyses to monitor and enhance the results required by the Company.

Your Essentials

Hold a valid passport

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

La Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing e CRO Manager saranno responsabili della crescita del D2C attraverso la sperimentazione basata sui dati e l'ottimizzazione strategica dei nostri canali digitali diretti. Potrai testare la nostra strategia di test e approfondimenti per massimizzare i tassi di conversione, la prenotazione di volumi e ricavi per visitatore, mentre la costruzione di una pratica di sperimentazione migliore in classe che offre un vantaggio competitivo sostenibile. Questo ruolo avrà una forte attenzione strategica sul canale diretto, ottimizzando la generazione di piombo, e sfruttando intuizioni per guidare l'acquisizione, l'impegno e il valore di vita del cliente più elevato.

Il tuo impatto

• Progettare ed eseguire una strategia globale basata sui dati in tutti i punti di contatto digitali, con particolare attenzione alla guida della crescita dei canali diretti e alla riduzione dei costi di acquisizione attraverso un miglioramento dei tassi di conversione.

• Collabora con team interfunzionali tra cui prodotti, design, ingegneria, marketing e analisi web per concettualizzare e progettare test A/B che misurano efficacemente l'impatto dei cambiamenti del sito web e della campagna.

• Guidare iniziative strategiche all'interno del canale diretto, garantendo un approccio basato sui dati per la generazione di lead, la segmentazione del pubblico e l'ottimizzazione del customer journey per migliorare la conversione e l'impegno.

• Sviluppare approfondimenti di viaggio dei clienti attraverso analisi avanzate, identificare punti di attrito chiave e opportunità per migliorare l'esperienza degli utenti e guidare valori di prenotazione più elevati.

• Eseguire analisi di segmentazione digitale avanzate per scoprire segmenti di clienti ad alto valore e opportunità di personalizzazione attraverso l'imbuto di conversione.

• Stabilire solidi quadri di misura per quantificare l'impatto commerciale delle iniziative di ottimizzazione, tra cui la progettazione di test, la previsione dei ricavi e l'analisi post-implementazione.

• Sviluppa dashboard di prestazioni complete che combinano risultati di test, metriche del comportamento del cliente e KPI commerciali per guidare l'ottimizzazione dei tassi di conversione.

• Guida l'innovazione nelle strategie di personalizzazione e ottimizzazione per massimizzare il contributo diretto dei canali utilizzando gli strumenti di nuova adozione (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Sviluppare framework di test che bilancia rapidamente vince con iniziative strategiche a lungo termine.

Il tuo viaggio finora

• Laurea in business, marketing, analisi o un campo relativo, con 5 anni di esperienza rilevante.

• Provato track record di sfruttare intuizioni di dati D2C per modellare le strategie di marketing e di prodotto, in particolare nella prenotazione di ottimizzazione deimbuti.

• Esperienza pratica con strumenti di test A/B come Adobe Target.

I tuoi essenziali

• Esperienza nelle piattaforme di analisi web come Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics e AEP.

• Forte mentalità analitica con la capacità di distillare i dati complessi in strategie aziendali attuabili.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente tra i team e influenzare il processo decisionale.

• Capacità di prosperare in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione, gestendo più iniziative contemporaneamente.

• EU Passport o diritto di lavoro in Svizzera.

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. descriptionByLocale.de:
Dein Zweck

Der Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing und CRO Manager wird dafür verantwortlich sein, das D2C-Wachstum durch datengesteuertes Experimentieren und strategische Optimierung unserer direkten digitalen Kanäle voranzutreiben. Sie werden unsere Test- und Insight-Strategie anführen, um Konversionsraten, Buchungsvolumen und Umsatz pro Besucher zu maximieren und gleichzeitig eine erstklassige Experimentierpraxis aufzubauen, die einen nachhaltigen Wettbewerbsvorteil bietet. Diese Rolle wird einen starken strategischen Fokus auf den direkten Kanal, die Optimierung der Lead-Generierung und die Nutzung von Erkenntnissen haben, um die Kundenakquise, das Engagement und den Lifetime-Wert zu erhöhen.

Ihre Wirkung

• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie eine umfassende datenbasierte Strategie über alle digitalen Touchpoints hinweg, mit besonderem Fokus auf der Förderung des direkten Channel-Wachstums und der Senkung der Akquisitionskosten durch verbesserte Conversion-Raten.

• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, einschließlich Produkt-, Design-, Engineering-, Marketing- und Webanalysen, um A / B-Tests zu konzipieren und zu entwerfen, die die Auswirkungen von Website- und Kampagnenänderungen effektiv messen.

• Führen Sie strategische Initiativen innerhalb des direkten Kanals durch und gewährleisten Sie einen datengesteuerten Ansatz zur Lead-Generierung, Zielgruppensegmentierung und Optimierung der Customer Journey, um die Conversion und das Engagement zu verbessern.

• Entwickeln Sie tiefe Customer Journey Insights durch fortschrittliche Analysen, identifizieren Sie wichtige Reibungspunkte und Möglichkeiten, um die Benutzererfahrung zu verbessern und höhere Buchungswerte zu erzielen.

• Führen Sie fortschrittliche digitale Segmentierungsanalysen durch, um hochwertige Kundensegmente und Personalisierungsmöglichkeiten im gesamten Conversion Funnel aufzudecken.

• Etablieren Sie robuste Messrahmen, um die kommerziellen Auswirkungen von Optimierungsinitiativen zu quantifizieren, einschließlich Testdesign, Umsatzprognosen und Post-Implementierungsanalysen.

• Entwickeln Sie umfassende Performance-Dashboards, die Testergebnisse, Metriken zum Kundenverhalten und kommerzielle KPIs kombinieren, um die Optimierung der Conversion-Rate zu steuern.

• Förderung von Innovationen bei Personalisierungs- und Optimierungsstrategien zur Maximierung des direkten Kanalbeitrags mit den neu eingeführten Tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Entwicklung von Test-Frameworks, die schnelle Gewinne mit längerfristigen strategischen Initiativen in Einklang bringen.

Deine Reise bisher

• Abschluss in Business, Marketing, Analytics oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit 5 Jahren einschlägiger Erfahrung.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Nutzung von D2C-Datenerkenntnissen zur Gestaltung von Marketing- und Produktstrategien, insbesondere bei der Buchungstrichteroptimierung.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit A/B-Testing-Tools wie Adobe Target.

Ihre Essentials

• Expertise in Webanalyseplattformen wie Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics und AEP.

• Starke analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten in umsetzbare Geschäftsstrategien zu destillieren.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, teamübergreifend effektiv zusammenzuarbeiten und die Entscheidungsfindung zu beeinflussen.

• Fähigkeit, in einer schnelllebigen, sich entwickelnden Umgebung zu gedeihen und mehrere Initiativen gleichzeitig zu verwalten.

• EU-Pass oder Recht auf Arbeit in der Schweiz.

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die verschiedene Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben sie sich noch heute, um teil eines globalen teams zu sein, das grenzen überschreitet und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

Vous serez le fer de lance de notre stratégie de test et d'information pour maximiser les taux de conversion, les volumes de réservation et les revenus par visiteur, tout en construisant une pratique d'expérimentation de meilleure qualité qui offre un avantage concurrentiel durable. Ce rôle sera fortement axé sur le canal direct, l'optimisation de la production de plomb et la mise à profit des idées pour accroître l'acquisition, l'engagement et la valeur à vie des clients.

Votre impact

• Concevoir et exécuter une stratégie globale axée sur les données dans tous les points de contact numériques, en mettant l'accent sur la croissance des canaux directs et la réduction des coûts d'acquisition grâce à des taux de conversion améliorés.

• Collaborer avec les équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris les produits, la conception, l'ingénierie, le marketing et l'analyse Web, pour conceptualiser et concevoir des tests A/B qui mesurent efficacement l'impact des changements apportés au site Web et à la campagne.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

- The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.
Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Develop attribution models (e.g.  media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency.

- Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

Il tuo viaggio finora - 5+ anni di esperienza precedente in analisi di marketing, analisi commerciali, business intelligence o analisi di marketing delle prestazioni. - Preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso / viaggio o agenzie di consulenza. - Corso di laurea in Business, Economia, Finanza, Marketing, Commerciale o relativo campo (Master, MBA o equivalente esperienza preferita). I tuoi essenziali - Esperienza comprovata che supporta i dirigenti senior e prospera in un ambiente di avvio veloce, gestendo più priorità contemporaneamente. - Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight aziendali attuabili. - Eccezionale competenza in Excel e comoda manipolazione di dati di grandi dimensioni e mantenimento di grandi fogli di calcolo con alto livello di precisione - Straordinarie competenze di PowerPoint e storytelling — in grado di creare presentazioni pulite, croccanti, ad alto impatto per il pubblico C-suite. - Esperienza di lavoro con Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics o piattaforme simili, nonché strumenti di visualizzazione e BI come Tableau, Power BI, Looker o piattaforme simili. - Conoscenza delle metodologie di misura di marketing tra cui la modellazione dell'attribuzione, la modellazione dei media, la segmentazione dei clienti e l'analisi ROI. - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. Fluente in inglese. - Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria del viaggio in continua evoluzione. A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia. 
• Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare. Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Your Impact

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees.

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- leadership pipeline development

- career development frameworks

- Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore.

- Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks.

Leadership Development

- Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations.

- Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture.

- Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as:

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

Your Journey so far

Education

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development.

- Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces.

- Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations.

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

Key Competences

- Strategic Learning & Capability Development

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture

- Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organizational Development

- Learning Technology & Digital Learning

Your Essentials

- Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) e Talent Management (Ashore) è responsabile per la definizione e la guida della strategia globale per l'apprendimento e lo sviluppo su entrambi i dipendenti della nave e della riva, mentre supervisiona Talent Management e la pianificazione di successo per le popolazioni a base di riva.
Il ruolo assicura che l'azienda sviluppi le capacità necessarie per offrire esperienze ospiti eccezionali, l'eccellenza operativa e una forte leadership in una forza lavoro globale, tra cui migliaia di equipaggio di bordo e una diversa organizzazione a base di riva.
Per i dipendenti di bordo, il ruolo si concentra sulla costruzione di capacità operative e di servizio di livello mondiale attraverso la formazione strutturata, lo sviluppo di leadership e le strutture di progressione di carriera che supportano le prestazioni della flotta e la soddisfazione degli ospiti.
Per i dipendenti a base di riva, il ruolo guida sia Learning & Development che Talent Management, tra cui sviluppo di leadership, pianificazione di successione e sviluppo di talenti pipeline per ruoli di leadership aziendale e operativa.
Lavorando a stretto contatto con i leader operativi senior in Operazioni, Esperienza degli Ospiti e Funzioni aziendali, questo ruolo guida una cultura dell’apprendimento continuo, dell’eccellenza della leadership e della capacità organizzativa attraverso le operazioni globali dell’azienda.

Il tuo impatto

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Definire e implementare la strategia globale di apprendimento e sviluppo che copre sia l'equipaggio di bordo che i dipendenti a base di riva.

- Sviluppare un ecosistema di apprendimento integrato che supporta l'eccellenza operativa a bordo e la capacità di leadership a terra.

- Assicurarsi che le iniziative di apprendimento supportino direttamente le priorità strategiche come:

- esperienza ospite eccellenza

- sicurezza e conformità

- performance operative

- efficacia della leadership

- trasformazione digitale e business

- Controllare i quadri di bordo e di sviluppo per accelerare l'integrazione e le prestazioni dei dipendenti in entrambi gli ambienti di bordo e riva.

- Guidare l'adozione di approcci di apprendimento moderni tra cui apprendimento digitale, formazione basata sulla simulazione, microlearning e soluzioni di apprendimento misto.

Imparare & Sviluppo

- Guidare la progettazione e la consegna della strategia globale di apprendimento e sviluppo del bordo nave in tutta la flotta.

- Collabora a stretto contatto con Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage e Guest Experience per garantire che i programmi di formazione supportino le priorità operative e l'eccellenza dei servizi.

- Assicurare standard di formazione coerenti in tutta la flotta, mentre accomunati le realtà operative degli ambienti di bordo.

- Superare i programmi di sviluppo per ruoli chiave di bordo, compresi i programmi di supervisione e sviluppo di gestione per i futuri leader di bordo.

- Supporto strutturato percorsi di sviluppo della carriera per l'equipaggio di bordo, consentendo progressione interna attraverso l'ospitalità e le funzioni operative.

- Assicurare l'allineamento con tutti i requisiti di formazione normativa marittima e standard di sicurezza.

Apprendimento e sviluppo basati sugli urti

- Guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione di programmi di apprendimento e sviluppo per dipendenti basati sulla riva attraverso funzioni aziendali e operative.

- Sviluppare iniziative di creazione di capacità a sostegno di priorità aziendali chiave come:

- capacità commerciali

- trasformazione digitale

- eccellenza operativa

- cultura ospite-centrica

- Design strutturato programmi di sviluppo di leadership per leader emergenti, di medio livello e senior.

- Sviluppare accademie funzionali e strutture di capacità che supportano le discipline aziendali critiche.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (solo Ashore)

- Definire e implementare la strategia globale di gestione del talento aziendale per i dipendenti a base di riva.

- Processi di piombo per:

- identificazione del talento e recensioni dei talenti

- pianificazione di successione per ruoli di leadership critici

- programmi di sviluppo ad alto potenziale

- sviluppo della leadership

- quadri di sviluppo della carriera

- Partner con leadership esecutiva e HR Business Partners per garantire forti condutture di successione per le posizioni di leadership aziendali e operative chiave a terra.

- Integrare le pratiche di gestione dei talenti nei quadri di gestione delle prestazioni e sviluppo della leadership.

Sviluppo della leadership

- Progettare e implementare programmi di sviluppo di leadership che supportano sia le popolazioni di leadership a bordo che a riva.

- Stabilire un quadro di leadership globale allineato con i valori della società e la cultura guest-centric.

- Rafforzare le capacità di leadership in settori come:

- leadership persone

- processo decisionale operativo

- servizio eccellenza

- innovazione e miglioramento continuo

- leadership interculturale

Il tuo viaggio finora

Istruzione

- Laurea magistrale in Risorse umane, Sviluppo organizzativo, Business Administration, o campo relativo.

Esperienza

- 15+ anni di esperienza progressiva nell'apprendimento e nello sviluppo, nella gestione dei talenti o nello sviluppo organizzativo.

- Esperienza significativa nella progettazione e nell'attuazione di strategie di apprendimento globali per le grandi forze di lavoro internazionali.

- Esperienza comprovata leader nella gestione del talento e programmi di pianificazione di successione per le popolazioni di leadership aziendale.

- Esperienza in crociera, ospitalità, viaggio, aviazione, o altre grandi organizzazioni di servizi fortemente preferiti.

- Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti altamente multiculturali e geograficamente distribuiti.

Competenze chiave

- Apprendimento Strategico e Sviluppo Capability

- Gestione dei talenti e pianificazione della successione (Corporate)

- Servizio Eccellenza & Ospitalità Cultura

- Influenza degli stakeholder e partenariato esecutivo

- Mindset globale e intelligenza culturale

- Sviluppo organizzativo

- Tecnologia di apprendimento e apprendimento digitale

I tuoi essenziali

- È richiesta una fluidità in inglese; italiano, francese, tedesco o altre lingue europee sono un plus.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Dein Zweck

Der Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) und Talent Management (Ashore) ist dafür verantwortlich, die globale Strategie für Lernen und Entwicklung sowohl für Mitarbeiter an Bord als auch an Land zu definieren und zu leiten, während er Talent Management und Nachfolgeplanung nur für an Land ansässige Bevölkerungen überwacht.
Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass das Unternehmen die Fähigkeiten entwickelt, die erforderlich sind, um außergewöhnliche Gästeerlebnisse, operative Exzellenz und eine starke Führungsrolle in einer globalen Belegschaft zu bieten, darunter Tausende von Schiffsbesatzungen und eine vielfältige landgestützte Organisation.
Für Mitarbeiter an Bord von Schiffen konzentriert sich die Rolle auf den Aufbau von erstklassigen Betriebs- und Servicefähigkeiten durch strukturierte Schulungen, Führungsentwicklung und Karriereentwicklungsrahmen, die die Leistung der Flotte und die Gästezufriedenheit unterstützen.
Für Mitarbeiter an Land führt die Rolle sowohl Learning & Development als auch Talent Management, einschließlich Führungskräfteentwicklung, Nachfolgeplanung und Talentpipeline-Entwicklung für Unternehmens- und operative Führungsrollen.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Führungskräften in den Bereichen Operations, Guest Experience und Corporate Functions treibt diese Rolle eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens, der Exzellenz von Führungskräften und des Aufbaus organisatorischer Fähigkeiten in den globalen Aktivitäten des Unternehmens voran.

Ihre Wirkung

Globale Lern- und Entwicklungsstrategie (Onboard & Ashore)

- Definieren und implementieren Sie die globale Lern- und Entwicklungsstrategie, die sowohl die Schiffsbesatzung als auch die Mitarbeiter an Land abdeckt.

- Entwicklung eines integrierten Lernökosystems, das operative Exzellenz an Bord und Führungskompetenz an Land unterstützt.

- Sicherstellen, dass Lerninitiativen strategische Prioritäten direkt unterstützen, wie:

- Gasterlebnis Exzellenz

- Sicherheit und Einhaltung

- Betriebsleistung

- Führungswirksamkeit

- Digitale und Business Transformation

- Beaufsichtigen Sie Onboarding- und Entwicklungs-Frameworks, um die Integration und Leistung der Mitarbeiter sowohl an Bord als auch an Land zu beschleunigen.

- Führen Sie die Einführung moderner Lernansätze wie digitales Lernen, simulationsbasiertes Training, Microlearning und Blended-Learning-Lösungen an.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Umsetzung der globalen Lern- und Entwicklungsstrategie an Bord der gesamten Flotte.

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Führung von Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage und Guest Experience, um sicherzustellen, dass Schulungsprogramme die operativen Prioritäten und Service-Exzellenz unterstützen.

- Gewährleistung einheitlicher Ausbildungsstandards für die gesamte Flotte und gleichzeitige Berücksichtigung der betrieblichen Gegebenheiten an Bord.

- Beaufsichtigen Sie Entwicklungsprogramme für wichtige Bordrollen, einschließlich Aufsichts- und Managemententwicklungsprogramme für zukünftige Bordleiter.

- Unterstützen Sie strukturierte Karriereentwicklungspfade für die Schiffsbesatzung, die interne Fortschritte in den Bereichen Gastfreundschaft und Betriebsfunktionen ermöglichen.

- Gewährleistung der Angleichung an alle Ausbildungsanforderungen und Sicherheitsstandards für die maritime Regulierung.

Landgestütztes Lernen & Entwicklung

- Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Lern- und Entwicklungsprogrammen für Mitarbeiter an Land in allen Unternehmens- und Betriebsfunktionen.

- Entwicklung von Initiativen zum Aufbau von Fähigkeiten zur Unterstützung wichtiger Geschäftsprioritäten wie:

- kommerzielle Kapazitäten

- Digitale Transformation

- Operative Exzellenz

- Gastzentrierte Kultur

- Entwerfen Sie strukturierte Führungsentwicklungsprogramme für aufstrebende, mittlere und leitende Führungskräfte.

- Entwicklung funktionaler Akademien und Fähigkeitsrahmen, die kritische Unternehmensdisziplinen unterstützen.

Talent Management & Nachfolgeplanung (nur an Land)

- Definieren und implementieren Sie die globale Talentmanagement-Strategie des Unternehmens für Mitarbeiter an Land.

- Leitprozesse für:

- Talentidentifizierung und Talent Reviews

- Nachfolgeplanung für kritische Führungsrollen

- Entwicklungsprogramme mit hohem Potenzial

- Leadership Pipeline Entwicklung

- Laufbahnentwicklungsrahmen

- Partnerschaft mit Führungskräften und HR Business Partners, um starke Nachfolge-Pipelines für wichtige Unternehmens- und operative Führungspositionen an Land sicherzustellen.

- Einbetten von Talent-Management-Praktiken in Performance-Management und Führungskräfteentwicklung Frameworks.

Führungskräfteentwicklung

- Entwerfen und implementieren Sie Führungsentwicklungsprogramme, die sowohl die Führungsbevölkerung an Bord als auch an Land unterstützen.

- Etablieren Sie einen globalen Führungsrahmen, der sich an den Werten und der gastorientierten Kultur des Unternehmens orientiert.

- Stärkung der Führungskompetenzen in Bereichen wie:

- Menschenführung

- operative Entscheidungsfindung

- Service Excellence

- Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung

- Interkulturelle Führung

Deine Reise bisher

Bildung

- Master-Abschluss in Human Resources, Organisationsentwicklung, Business Administration oder verwandten Bereichen.

Erfahrung

- 15+ Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in Learning & Development, Talent Management oder Organisationsentwicklung.

- Bedeutende Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung globaler Lernstrategien für große, internationale Arbeitskräfte.

- Bewährte Erfahrung in führenden Talentmanagement- und Nachfolgeplanungsprogrammen für Unternehmensführungsgruppen.

- Erfahrung in Kreuzfahrt, Gastfreundschaft, Reise, Luftfahrt oder anderen großen Service-getriebenen Organisationen stark bevorzugt.

- Erfahrung in hochgradig multikulturellen und geografisch verteilten Umgebungen.

- Talent Management & Nachfolgeplanung (Unternehmen)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Kultur

- Stakeholder-Einfluss & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organisationsentwicklung

- Lerntechnologie & Digitales Lernen

Ihre Essentials

- Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Italienisch, Französisch, Deutsch oder andere europäische Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Votre but

Le responsable de l'apprentissage et du perfectionnement (à bord et à terre) et de la gestion des talents (à terre) est chargé de définir et de diriger la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement des employés à bord et à terre, tout en surveillant la gestion des talents et la planification de la relève pour les populations à terre seulement.
Ce rôle permet à l'entreprise de développer les capacités nécessaires pour offrir aux clients des expériences exceptionnelles, l'excellence opérationnelle et un leadership solide à l'échelle mondiale, y compris des milliers d'équipages de bord et une organisation à terre diversifiée.
Pour les employés de bord, le rôle consiste à renforcer les capacités opérationnelles et de service de calibre mondial par la formation structurée, le perfectionnement en leadership et les cadres de progression de carrière qui appuient le rendement de la flotte et la satisfaction des clients.
Pour les employés à terre, le rôle est à la fois responsable de l'apprentissage et du perfectionnement et de la gestion des talents, y compris le perfectionnement en leadership, la planification de la relève et le perfectionnement des compétences en leadership organisationnel et opérationnel.
Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des dirigeants opérationnels supérieurs dans l'ensemble des opérations, de l'expérience des invités et des fonctions ministérielles, ce rôle est à l'origine d'une culture d'apprentissage continu, d'excellence en leadership et de renforcement des capacités organisationnelles dans l'ensemble des opérations mondiales de l'entreprise.

Votre impact

Stratégie mondiale d'apprentissage et de développement (à bord et à terre)

- Définir et mettre en oeuvre la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de développement qui couvre à la fois les équipages et les employés à terre.

- Élaborer un écosystème d'apprentissage intégré qui appuie l'excellence opérationnelle à bord et la capacité de leadership à terre.

- Veiller à ce que les initiatives d'apprentissage appuient directement les priorités stratégiques telles que :

- Expérience invitée excellence

- sécurité et conformité

- performance opérationnelle

- efficacité de la direction

- transformation numérique et des entreprises

- Superviser les cadres d'intégration et de perfectionnement afin d'accélérer l'intégration et le rendement des employés à bord des navires et à terre.

- Diriger l'adoption d'approches d'apprentissage modernes, y compris l'apprentissage numérique, la formation fondée sur la simulation, le microapprentissage et les solutions d'apprentissage mixte.

Apprentissage et développement à bord

- Diriger la conception et la prestation de la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de développement à bord des navires dans l'ensemble de la flotte.

- S'associer étroitement aux opérations maritimes, aux opérations hôtelières, aux aliments et boissons et à la direction de l'Expérience invitée pour s'assurer que les programmes de formation appuient les priorités opérationnelles et l'excellence des services.

- Assurer l'uniformité des normes de formation dans l'ensemble de la flotte tout en tenant compte des réalités opérationnelles des environnements de bord.

- Superviser les programmes de perfectionnement pour les rôles clés à bord des navires, y compris les programmes de supervision et de perfectionnement de la gestion pour les futurs dirigeants à bord.

- Soutenir des parcours structurés de perfectionnement professionnel pour les équipages de navires, permettant une progression interne dans l'ensemble des fonctions d'accueil et d'exploitation.

- Assurer l'alignement sur toutes les exigences en matière de formation réglementaire maritime et les normes de sécurité.

Apprentissage et développement à terre

- Diriger la conception et la mise en oeuvre de programmes d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour les employés à terre dans toutes les fonctions ministérielles et opérationnelles.

- Élaborer des initiatives de renforcement des capacités à l'appui des principales priorités opérationnelles, notamment :

- Capacités commerciales

- transformation numérique

- excellence opérationnelle

- Culture centrée sur les invités

- Concevoir des programmes structurés de perfectionnement en leadership à l'intention des dirigeants émergents, moyens et supérieurs.

- Élaborer des académies fonctionnelles et des cadres de capacités qui appuient les disciplines organisationnelles essentielles.

Gestion des talents et planification de la relève (à terre seulement)

- Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie globale de gestion des talents pour les employés à terre.

- Processus principaux pour:

- identification des talents et examens des talents

- Planification de la relève pour les rôles critiques de leadership

- Programmes de développement à fort potentiel

- développement de pipelines de leadership

- cadres d ' organisation des carrières

- Établir des partenariats avec les cadres supérieurs et les partenaires d'affaires des RH afin d'assurer une relève solide pour les postes clés de leadership organisationnel et opérationnel à terre.

- Intégrer les pratiques de gestion des talents dans les cadres de gestion du rendement et de perfectionnement du leadership.

Développement du leadership

- Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des programmes de perfectionnement en leadership à l'appui des populations de dirigeants à bord et à terre.

- Établir un cadre de leadership mondial aligné sur les valeurs de l'entreprise et la culture centrée sur les invités.

- Renforcer les capacités de leadership dans des domaines tels que :

- leadership humain

- prise de décisions opérationnelles

- excellence des services

- innovation et amélioration continue

- Leadership interculturel

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

Éducation

- Maîtrise en ressources humaines, développement organisationnel, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe.

Expérience

- 15 ans et plus d'expérience progressive en apprentissage et développement, gestion des talents ou développement organisationnel.

- Expérience importante dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de stratégies d'apprentissage à l'échelle mondiale pour les travailleurs internationaux de grande taille.

- Expérience éprouvée des programmes de gestion des talents et de planification de la relève à l'intention des populations de leadership ministériel.

- Expérience de croisière, d'accueil, de voyage, d'aviation ou d'autres grandes organisations axées sur le service fortement préféré.

- Expérience de travail dans des environnements très multiculturels et géographiquement répartis.

Compétences clés

- Apprentissage stratégique et développement des capacités

- Gestion des talents et planification de la relève (société)

- Excellence du service et culture d'accueil

- Influence des intervenants et partenariat exécutif

- Intelligence globale et culturelle

- Développement organisationnel

- Apprentissage Technologie & Apprentissage numérique

Vos essentiels

- La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise; l'italien, le français, l'allemand ou d'autres langues européennes sont un plus.

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

jobs.title: Mobile App Product Specialist
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

Your Impact

- Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates.

- Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users.

- Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Drive MSC for Me  channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base.

- Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me  in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications.

- Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus).

- Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations.

- Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems.

- Strong business acumen with a focus on maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and removing friction from the mobile buying experience.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.

VISA REQUIREMENTS (if any) :

- Right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il tuo viaggio finora - Laurea o master in Business Administration, Economia, Marketing Management, Digital o un campo relativo. - Forte capacità commerciali e analitiche con 3 a 5 anni di comprovata esperienza nelle vendite digitali, nella crescita del prodotto o nello sviluppo aziendale digitale, con un focus rigoroso sulle applicazioni mobili. - Esperienza pratica con l'analisi delle app, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), e strumenti di manipolazione/visualizzazione dei dati (Power BI, SQL; Python è un plus). - Familiarità con metodologie agili e capacità di lavorare fianco a fianco con sviluppatori e product manager in ambienti dinamici e veloci. - Ottima capacitÃ di comunicazione e collaborazione, con la capacitÃ di tradurre intuizioni basate sui dati in raccomandazioni aziendali e di prodotto attuabili. - Pensatore creativo con un approccio proattivo al problem-solving, capace di guidare "Product-Led Growth" piuttosto che contare sulla spesa di marketing tradizionale. - Fluente in inglese; lingue europee aggiuntive sono un plus. I tuoi essenziali - Profonda comprensione del comportamento degli utenti mobili, imbuti di vendita digitali e ecosistemi di acquisizione orientati al prodotto. - Forte business acumen con un focus su massimizzare il valore di vita del cliente (CLV) e rimuovere l'attrito dall'esperienza di acquisto mobile. - Capacità di gestire più priorità e fornire output di alta qualità in tempi brevi. REQUISITI VISA (se presenti) : - Diritto di lavorare in Svizzera. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

descriptionByLocale.de: Dein Zweck Wir suchen einen dynamischen und hochmotivierten Mobile App Produktspezialisten, der sich unserem Business Innovation Team am MSC Cruises Hauptsitz in Genf anschließt. Diese Rolle richtet sich an einen datengesteuerten Fachmann mit einem starken kommerziellen Scharfsinn, einer analytischen Denkweise und einer Leidenschaft für die Optimierung von mobilen Benutzerreisen. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird das In-App-Verhalten untersuchen, Reibungen im Verkaufstrichter beseitigen und produktgeführte Initiativen vorantreiben, um die Konversionsraten zu maximieren und die Zukunft der digitalen Gästeerlebnisse im gesamten digitalen Ökosystem von MSC for Me zu gestalten. Ihre Wirkung - Analysieren Sie die In-App-User-Journey und das Verhalten von MSC for Me, um Engpässe zu identifizieren und Produktinitiativen vorzuschlagen und zu validieren, die den Sales Funnel optimieren und die In-App-Konversionsraten steigern. - Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Produkt-, Technologie- und UX/UI-Teams zusammen, um Funktionen zu entwerfen und zu implementieren, die die organische Nutzerakquise vorantreiben und die Cross-Selling-/Up-Selling-Möglichkeiten für das digitale Ökosystem MSC for Me erhöhen. - Implementieren und optimieren Sie die In-App-Position kommerzieller Angebote (Arbeiten mit der Onboard Revenues Commercial Abteilung), um die Sichtbarkeit und Umsatzkonversion speziell für mobile Benutzer zu maximieren. - Verwenden Sie fortschrittliche Produktanalyse-Tools und Datenvisualisierung (Power BI), um die Verkaufsleistung, die Aktivierungsraten der Benutzer und die Rückgaben in das digitale Ökosystem von MSC for Me zu verfolgen. - Handeln Sie als Brücke zwischen der Onboard Revenues Commercial-Abteilung und den Tech / Development-Teams und übersetzen Sie Umsatzziele in klare digitale Produktanforderungen, um das digitale Ökosystem von MSC for Me zu verbessern. - Fahren Sie die kanalgeführte Akquisition von MSC for Me durch die Verfeinerung nativer In-App-Funktionen wie reibungslose Gast-zu-registrierte Benutzerströme, Mechanismen für Einladungen und nahtloses App-Sharing, um die Benutzerbasis zu vergrößern. - Führen Sie A/B-Tests auf MSC for Me In-App-Verkaufsströmen, Checkout-Prozessen und Abonnementmodellen durch, um die betriebliche Effizienz und Umsatzgenerierung kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Deine Reise bisher - Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaft, Marketing Management, Digital oder einem verwandten Bereich. - Starke kaufmännische und analytische Fähigkeiten mit 3 bis 5 Jahren nachgewiesener Erfahrung im digitalen Vertrieb, Produktwachstum oder in der digitalen Geschäftsentwicklung mit einem strikten Fokus auf mobile Anwendungen. - Praktische Erfahrung mit App-Analysen, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) und Datenmanipulations- / Visualisierungstools (Power BI, SQL; Python ist ein Plus). - Vertrautheit mit agilen Methoden und Fähigkeit, Seite an Seite mit Entwicklern und Produktmanagern in dynamischen, schnelllebigen Umgebungen zu arbeiten. - Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse in umsetzbare Geschäfts- und Produktempfehlungen zu übersetzen. - Kreativer Denker mit einem proaktiven Ansatz zur Problemlösung, der in der Lage ist, "produktgeführtes Wachstum" voranzutreiben, anstatt sich auf traditionelle Marketingausgaben zu verlassen. - Fließend Englisch; zusätzliche europäische Sprachen sind ein Plus. Ihre Essentials - Tiefes Verständnis des mobilen Nutzerverhaltens, digitaler Verkaufstrichter und produktorientierter Akquisitionsökosysteme. - Starker Geschäftssinn mit dem Fokus auf der Maximierung des Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) und der Beseitigung von Reibungen aus dem mobilen Kauferlebnis. - Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten und qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse unter engen Fristen zu liefern. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken. Ce rôle est conçu pour un professionnel axé sur les données et doté d'un sens commercial fort, d'un état d'esprit analytique et d'une passion pour l'optimisation des parcours des utilisateurs mobiles. Le candidat retenu explorera les comportements dans l'application, éliminera les frictions dans l'entonnoir de vente, et animera des initiatives axées sur les produits afin de maximiser les taux de conversion et de façonner l'avenir des expériences d'invités numériques dans l'écosystème numérique du SMC pour moi. Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling.

- Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution.

- Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals.

- Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations.

- Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets.

- Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams

- Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives.

- Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment.

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field.

- 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building.

- Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred.

- Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets.

- Experience managing agencies and external creative partners.

Your Essentials

- Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable).

- Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.title: Junior Architect Port Development Intern
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

The Junior Architect Port Development Intern must be enrolled in a study program requiring a valid internship agreement. Candidates must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
